gen-fredoka-gf-lisu-bosa: Round, friendly, and drawn with one steady line. Fredoka keeps the top light and approachable, while Lisu Bosa's tall, sturdy lowercase gives the text beneath it an editorial footing.
gen-fs-be-vietnam-pro-roboto-slab: Clean lines up top, with a slab-serif underneath. Be Vietnam Pro traces every curve like one marker stroke, and Roboto Slab sits beside it feeling precise and structured.
gen-fs-britney-fs-synonym: Britney writes in a relaxed, calligraphic hand with very narrow spacing. Synonym steps in below with generous curve openings to keep things readable, though neither font is made for pages of dense text.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-familjen-grote: Marker-bold up top, with a contemporary swagger. Red Hat Display is best at bold, marker-like lines with daylight in every curve, while Familjen Grotesk is best at lively text with bowls left open on one side.
gen-fs-segment-montserrat: Segment leaves wide gaps between its letters and stacks a stocky, tall middle band into every line, which feels commanding. Montserrat glides smoothly beneath it, a good fit for brief reading.
gen-fs-styro-fs-hoover: Retro and crowded, with letters pressed shoulder to shoulder. Styro's tight, closed shapes get relief from Hoover, a serif whose open e eyes and short ascenders keep brief text refined.
gen-fs-teko-fs-bespoke-sans: Tightly packed letters cut from strokes like bent steel rod. What stands out most is how Teko's rigid, uniform line meets the sharper, more open curves of Bespoke Sans.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-cascadia-code: Spaghetti-like and commanding: Funnel Display keeps every stroke one width, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Cascadia Code reads smoothly, its wire-like lines giving each bend a clear path.
gen-gf-gajraj-one-fs-karma: Karma, trustworthy and classic, lets its terminals finish well away from the stem, with modulation that never snags. Gajraj One earns its keep big, in just a few words.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-cascadia-code: Bookish authority with a wide, inviting turn to every round letter. Lisu Bosa does best with mild stroke contrast easing the pace, while Cascadia Code does best with widely spaced, wire-like lines.
